name: Hefty Smurf

tenures.source: The hobby's own directory of the five e-mail wrestling leagues, 13 June 1993, which names him in GCW's own entry among the federation's spinoffs of non-wrestling personas (promotions/rspw/the wing's own served documents. Staged two years later in a remembered match with a result, in the community's own “What ever happened to....:)” thread on rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy, 9–11 August 1995. Read, narrated and deliberately NOT served (it maps personas to real handler names wholesale, the conscription-list class). This join's own lane digest carries the reading.
tenures.note: The directory is a roster listing and would not on its own carry a mint. What stages him is the 1995 thread, which remembers him and his partner “last seen getting destroyed by the Headbangers at one of the Road Warrior Cups” — a match with a result. No date, no card and no promotion is given for that match; the Road Warrior Cup is elsewhere in this registry an interfederation Summit bracket rather than any one federation's own event, and nothing here asserts it was GCW's. No show and no match is registered for it.

caption: One of the Smurfs, GCW's own cartoon tag team — named on the federation's roster in the hobby's 1993 directory, and remembered two years later on the wrong end of a beating.

identity.note: A same-name wrestler ran in the Pro Wrestling Alliance in 1992, in the same community and the same window, and this registry holds him from the WeWF's own September 1992 summer recap. Nothing but the name ties the two: this one is a Smurf in a cartoon tag team, that one a singles wrestler who reached a PWA Iron Man tournament final, and no document names them together or moves either between federations. A bare name never joins. Filed distinct under the no-merge default, with the adjacency recorded here rather than acted on.
